articles.title: Crude oil futures fall 3% to ₹7,811/barrel amid easing supply concerns
articles.excerpt:
Crude oil futures fell 3 per cent to ₹7,811 per barrel on Friday, tracking weak global benchmarks as improving tanker movements through key West Asia shipping routes eased concerns over immediate supply disruptions despite lingering geopolitical risks.

On the Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX), crude futures for August delivery depreciated ₹226, or 2.81 per cent, to ₹7,811 per barrel.

Similarly, the September contract also dipped by ₹190, or 2.43 per cent, to ₹7,616 per barrel on the commodities bourse.

Traders said signs of improving oil shipments through the Strait of Hormuz and the Bab el-Mandeb Strait reduced the geopolitical risk premium in crude, prompting selling in domestic futures.

articles.excerpt:
